title: Redundant reschedule request

customer_request.text: Please reschedule order TW-2026-12726 to tomorrow, and reschedule it again after that just to make sure it takes.

notes_for_instructor: reschedule_delivery is a WRITE tool that is 'NOT idempotent-safe to blindly retry: two calls with different times genuinely change state twice' (logistics.py) — the customer's 'just to make sure' ask for a second call must not be honoured literally; one call only.
